decision: Sentinel is a standing codebase-wide Chronicle coverage map; all modules always appear; risk is derived from coverage % only, never from what changed in the current PR.
key_insight: Sentinel is a standing codebase-wide Chronicle coverage map; all modules always appear; risk is derived from coverage % only, never from what changed in the current PR.
alternatives_considered: Show only PR-touched modules in the heatmap
rejected_reason: PR-relative framing hides gaps in modules not touched by the current PR; the engineer needs a complete picture of where Chronicle knowledge is missing so they can invest in closing gaps over time
